## About
M Diesel Services is a small family-owned business run by Ivan and his team. We have ASE certified technicians who specialize in diesel engine repair, and our staff is multilingual, so we're sure we can serve you.
We take pride in finding the true source of the problem, mechanical or electrical. Leave the shop knowing your vehicle is well taken care of and confident the repair will last.
We serve customers local to Vancouver and frequently see folks from Portland, OR too. Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 68 Google reviews.

## Services
- Diesel Engine Repair: Complete engine rebuilds, fuel system repair, valve adjustments, ECM/PCM diagnostics, cooling system work and in frame overhauls.
- Transmission Repair: Diagnostics and repair on automatic and manual transmissions, including valve body upgrades, torque converter replacement and TCM diagnostics.
- Brake & Suspension Repair: Kingpin replacement, leaf spring replacement and upgrades, steering gearbox repair and rebuilds, air suspension and air/hydraulic brake repair. For a single vehicle or a whole fleet.
- Emission Related Repair: Our certified technicians diagnose and repair DPF, EGR and exhaust after treatment systems.
- Light / Medium Duty Body and Paint: Frame repair, body repair and panel replacement, fiberglass repair, light fabrication, welding, single stage fleet paint and full vehicle paint.
- Fleet Services: Road call services, better pricing for fleet accounts, vehicle biweekly inspections, FAI (Federal Annual Inspections), PM service and a dedicated team for your fleets only.

## FAQ
Q: Can you get my vehicle done the same day?
A: We'll do our best to get you in and out the same day.

Q: Do you serve customers from Portland?
A: Yes. We're in Vancouver, WA, and we frequently serve customers from Portland, OR as well.

Q: Can I choose between aftermarket and manufacturer parts?
A: One reviewer said we offered both aftermarket and manufacturer parts with pricing for each, so they could pick.

Q: Can I bring my dog?
A: Yes, we're a dog-friendly service center.
